title: Update footer Facebook link text to 'Hasnain'

requirements.summary: Update the text content of the first social media link (Facebook icon link) in the Footer component to display 'Hasnain'
acceptanceCriteria: The first anchor element in the footer's social media links section displays the text 'Hasnain'.
The link retains its existing styling and behavior.
No other footer elements are modified.

file_operations.description: Locate the first social media anchor element in the footer (the Facebook icon link at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/footer[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/a[1]) and update its visible text or accessible label to 'Hasnain'. Ensure the link's styling, icon, href, and behavior remain unchanged. Only modify the text content or aria-label of this single anchor element without altering any other footer links, icons, or layout.
